name: Uniparts India Limited
summary: Uniparts India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells engineering systems, solutions, and assemblies primarily for off-highway vehicles in India, the United States, the Asia Pacific, Europe, Japan, and internationally. The company offers 3-point linkage systems, including rear and front hitch; precision machined parts, such as pins and brushes; power take-off products, fabrications, hydraulic cylinders, and other related components. It serves the agriculture, construction, forestry, mining, and aftermarket sectors, as well as original equipment manufacturers. Uniparts India Limited was founded in 1984 and is based in Noida, India.
